headline: Oswal Greentech submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Routine AGM filing from Oswal Greentech
summary: Oswal Greentech Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The filing completes the procedural compliance requirements following the company's annual shareholder gathering. For an Indian retail investor holding the stock, this confirms the formal conclusion of the AGM resolutions.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate price impact
